summary_en: Wel-Dish corrected prior disclosure regarding the complete subsidiary acquisition of IMG Holdings through stock exchange. The correction addresses a temporary shareholder composition that was previously disclosed instead of the original shareholder composition scheduled to be restored before the stock exchange completion.
title_en: Correction regarding "Notice on Complete Subsidiary Acquisition of IMG Holdings Corporation through Stock Exchange"
translation_en_brief:
This disclosure is a correction to Wel-Dish's prior announcement dated October 14, 2025, regarding the complete acquisition of IMG Holdings Corporation through a stock exchange. The company had announced plans to acquire IMG Holdings, with Wel-Dish becoming the parent company and IMG Holdings becoming a wholly owned subsidiary.

The correction was necessitated by findings from an independent investigation committee report published on August 10, 2026. The committee discovered that IMG Holdings shares had undergone a temporary transfer of ownership, with the original shareholder composition scheduled to be restored before the stock exchange was completed. However, Wel-Dish's original disclosure had presented only the temporary shareholder composition rather than the intended final composition.

The corrected disclosure now reflects the accurate shareholder structure of IMG Holdings that was intended to be in place at the time of the stock exchange transaction. This correction ensures that stakeholders have the correct information regarding the ownership structure of the target company at the time of acquisition.
